html:
For those of you who would like to read the Beta draft of my new Rho Agenda prequel novel, DEAD SHIFT (formerly DEADMAN WALKING), I just need you to add my email address (Richard.phillips@secondship.net) to your Amazon account’s Approved Document Senders list and then email me with your kindle’s email address (something@kindle.com).  Then I will push the free Beta draft to your device.  All I ask is that you not share this draft beyond your immediate family and that you let me know your general impressions of the novel.

This offer will remain open until my editors finish the final edit.
Best,
Richard Phillips
